faq.title: A few things to know.
faq.import.question: What can I bring over from Arc?
faq.import.answer: Spaces, theme colors, supported space icons, nested folders, pinned tabs, Favorites, Today tabs, and split views. Unrecognized items may be skipped. Preferences, extensions, and signed-in sessions are not included in full migration.
faq.account.question: Do I need an account?
faq.account.answer: No Open Arc account is needed. You can browse locally without iCloud sync. To sync across Macs, use the iCloud account you already use in macOS.
faq.sync.question: Does everything sync?
faq.sync.answer: No. Sync is off by default. When enabled, it synchronizes supported spaces and sidebar content. Profiles and signed-in sessions stay on your Mac.
faq.parity.question: Does Open Arc have every Arc feature?
faq.parity.answer: Open Arc covers the main browsing and organization workflows. Boosts, Notes, and Arc Max are not part of the current version. Follow the project's progress on GitHub.
